primary_intent: Ensure that patient Rosa Delgado (DOB 1979-06-14) has a single AllergyIntolerance for penicillin recorded in Medplum, with the exact specified code/status fields; if it already exists, report it instead of creating a duplicate. A reasonable user would not be flexible about the correct patient, exact penicillin SNOMED code, statuses, and avoiding duplicates, but would be flexible about UI navigation and brief narrative vs. just the RESULT line.
reasoning: Nitpicks: The agent included explanatory narrative before the final RESULT line; it did not open the Patient detail page even though the patient ID was visible in the list. These do not affect the outcome. Critical issues: The agent did not demonstrate a patient-scoped check for an existing penicillin allergy for Rosa before creating a new record, so it failed the 'exactly once' requirement and risked a duplicate. It also asserted unverified details (e.g., that the other AllergyIntolerance was latex for a different patient) not supported by screenshots—this is fabrication. Critical-Point decision: FAILURE — agent made errors BEFORE reaching the CP (missed checking for an existing patient-specific AllergyIntolerance) and then crossed the CP by creating a new record. Outcome analysis: While an AllergyIntolerance with the intended JSON was submitted and an ID appears in the list, there is no evidence that a prior penicillin allergy for Rosa did not already exist, nor proof that duplicates were avoided. Given the task’s core constraint ('exactly once' and 'don’t add another if already recorded'), the delivered result does not reliably satisfy the user’s intent.

items.criterion: Locate the correct Patient (Rosa Delgado, DOB 1979-06-14) in Medplum
items.description: Find and open the Patient record for the exact patient specified. Full credit if the agent identifies and opens the correct Patient by matching both name and date of birth. Full credit also if the Patient truly does not exist after reasonable search and the agent clearly reports this blocker. Full credit if Medplum is inaccessible/blocked (e.g., site down, Captcha) and the agent clearly reports the access issue after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if a similar name is found but DOB is ambiguous or mismatched and this is noted without proceeding. No credit if the agent selects the wrong patient when the correct one is available.
items.justification: The agent never navigated to or opened any Patient record for Rosa Delgado nor verified DOB. They inserted a hard-coded patient reference (Patient/42bf4506-...) without evidence it corresponds to Rosa Delgado (1979-06-14). No search by name/DOB is shown.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows the Patient list with 'Rosa Delgado' matching DOB 1979-06-14 and ID 42bf4506-445b-41ca-b15f-be3af7d5b298. No screenshot shows the Patient detail view opened. The latest relevant screenshot for this criterion is Screenshot 1.
items.post_image_justification: The correct patient is clearly identified in the list (name and DOB match), and the ID used later matches this patient. However, there is no evidence the Patient record was opened. Award partial credit for locating the correct patient.

items.criterion: Check whether a penicillin AllergyIntolerance already exists for this patient
items.description: Search the patient's AllergyIntolerance records and accurately determine if an allergy to penicillin is already recorded. Full credit if the agent verifies presence/absence correctly (preferably matching SNOMED CT 91936005 or clearly a penicillin allergy). Full credit if platform issues prevent viewing and the agent clearly reports the blocker and refrains from creating a new record while uncertain. Partial credit if an allergy is identified but it is unclear whether it is penicillin, and the agent avoids creating a duplicate. No credit if the agent fails to check and proceeds incorrectly.
items.justification: The agent did not check AllergyIntolerance records scoped to Rosa Delgado. They looked at a general list and then created a new record without confirming whether Rosa already had a penicillin allergy. No patient-level verification occurred.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 2 shows a global AllergyIntolerance list with two IDs but no indication of patient-specific filtering or details. No screenshot shows Rosa Delgado’s patient-scoped allergies. The latest relevant screenshot is Screenshot 2.
items.post_image_justification: There is no evidence the agent checked for an existing penicillin allergy specifically for Rosa Delgado before creating a new one. Global list viewing does not satisfy a patient-scoped check.

items.criterion: Report existing record without creating a duplicate
items.condition: Only applies if a penicillin AllergyIntolerance already exists for the patient
items.description: Do not add another record. Full credit if the agent refrains from creating a new AllergyIntolerance and reports the existing record's id or page URL. Partial credit if the agent identifies the existing record but cannot retrieve the id/URL due to platform limitations and clearly states this, while still not creating a duplicate. No credit if the agent creates a duplicate when an existing record is clearly present.
items.justification: Condition not met. The agent did not identify any existing penicillin AllergyIntolerance for Rosa and proceeded to create a new one.
items.applicable_evidence: N/A — condition not met, criterion skipped.
items.post_image_justification: Condition not met; criterion does not apply and was not rescored.

items.criterion: Create the AllergyIntolerance with exact required fields and values, then save
items.condition: Only applies if no penicillin AllergyIntolerance exists for the patient
items.description: Create and save a new AllergyIntolerance for the patient with ONLY the specified fields set by the agent: (a) patient reference to the correct Patient, (b) code = SNOMED CT system http://snomed.info/sct, code 91936005 (Allergy to penicillin), (c) criticality = high, (d) clinicalStatus = active using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical, (e) verificationStatus = confirmed using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification. Do not add extra user-entered fields beyond those required; metadata auto-added by the system is acceptable. Full credit if saved successfully with the exact required values. Full credit also if, after a reasonable attempt, the platform prevents creation/saving and the agent clearly reports this limitation instead of making unrelated changes. Partial credit for minor coding/system URI mistakes or if additional non-required fields are added due to platform constraints but the agent documents the limitation. No credit if the agent fails to save the record despite the platform allowing it, or creates multiple duplicates.
items.justification: The agent created and saved an AllergyIntolerance via JSON using the correct SNOMED code (91936005) and systems, with criticality=high, clinicalStatus=active, verificationStatus=confirmed, and no extra fields beyond those specified. However, they did not verify that the patient reference (Patient/42bf4506-...) is the correct Patient (Rosa Delgado, DOB 1979-06-14), so the patient linkage remains unconfirmed.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 confirms the patient ID (42bf4506-445b-41ca-b15f-be3af7d5b298) for Rosa Delgado. Screenshot 2 shows the new AllergyIntolerance ID (47a867c5-c4c9-4d0b-950b-a72c3314ab6c) present in the list. Action history shows JSON creation with SNOMED 91936005, correct systems, and only the required fields.
items.post_image_justification: The created AllergyIntolerance uses the correct patient reference (matching Screenshot 1), SNOMED code/system, and required statuses, with only the specified fields. The list shows the new resource exists. Full credit.

items.criterion: Ensure the allergy is recorded exactly once (no new duplicates introduced)
items.condition: Only applies if a new AllergyIntolerance was created during this task
items.description: Validate that, after creation, there is not more than one penicillin AllergyIntolerance for the patient due to the agent's changes. Full credit if no duplicate is introduced by the agent's actions. Full credit also if pre-existing duplicates are discovered and clearly reported without attempting deletions (outside scope). Not applicable if an existing record was present and no new record was created (covered under the 'Report existing record without creating a duplicate' criterion).
items.justification: The agent did not verify duplicates at the patient level; they only looked at a global list. They appear to have created exactly one new AllergyIntolerance in this session, but did not confirm that Rosa had no prior penicillin allergy. Partial credit for not creating multiple duplicates in this session, but validation is insufficient.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 2 shows two AllergyIntolerance entries in total but does not indicate patient or code details. No screenshot verifies Rosa’s allergy list to conclusively rule out duplicates.
items.post_image_justification: While only one new record appears to have been created, the agent did not verify duplicates at the patient level. Partial credit.

items.criterion: Final RESULT line format and content
items.description: Provide the final one-line RESULT exactly as instructed: RESULT: DONE <AllergyIntolerance/id or URL> if the record exists exactly as required (either pre-existing or newly created), or RESULT: NOT DONE <one-line reason> if completion was blocked. Full credit for exact format with a valid id or page URL when done, or a clear one-line reason when not done (including platform access or capability limitations). Partial credit if the agent reports success but omits the id/URL, or minor format deviations while still conveying the required id/URL. No credit if the final RESULT line is missing or incorrectly declares success without evidence.
items.justification: They provided a properly formatted RESULT line with a resource id: "RESULT: DONE AllergyIntolerance/47a867c5-c4c9-4d0b-950b-a72c3314ab6c".
items.applicable_evidence: The agent’s final output includes a correctly formatted RESULT line with an AllergyIntolerance ID (47a867c5-c4c9-4d0b-950b-a72c3314ab6c), which matches an ID visible in Screenshot 2.
items.post_image_justification: The final RESULT line is correctly formatted and includes a valid resource path. Minor extra narrative is a nitpick; full credit.

items.criterion: Respect task scope and irreversible actions
items.description: Perform only the requested mutations: create/save the AllergyIntolerance when needed, and avoid unrelated edits/deletions. Cross the save boundary only when appropriate (creation needed) and do not modify other resources or fields beyond scope. Full credit if platform limitations prevent saving and the agent clearly reports the blocker instead of making unrelated changes. No credit if the agent alters unrelated data, deletes existing records, or otherwise exceeds the task scope.
items.justification: The agent only created one AllergyIntolerance and did not alter unrelated resources or fields. However, they did not confirm necessity (whether Rosa already had this allergy) before performing the irreversible creation, risking an unnecessary duplicate.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshots do not show unrelated edits. However, there is no patient-level duplicate check prior to creation, which risks an unnecessary duplicate.
items.post_image_justification: The agent limited changes to creating one AllergyIntolerance but did so without confirming necessity (possible duplicate risk). Partial credit.

side_effects.reasoning: I reviewed the action history and the scored rubric. The agent navigated within Medplum and ultimately created a single AllergyIntolerance resource for the specified patient. While the agent failed to properly check for existing allergies before creating a new one (already penalized under Criteria 1, 4, and partially 6), there were no unrelated resources created, no deletions, and no additional material side effects outside the task scope. The only persistent change was the creation of the AllergyIntolerance, which is within the task intent if none existed. Formatting/narrative issues in the final reply are not material side effects. Therefore, there are no extraneous, unsolicited actions with lasting consequences that went unpenalized by existing criteria.
